def: The state of being thirsty; thirst.
Not circumcised; hence, not of the Israelites. "Thisuncircumcised Philistine." 1 Sam. xvii. 26.
Any plant of the composite genus Rudbeckia, coarse herbssomewhat resembling the sunflower; -- so called from their conicalreceptacles.
Abounding in capacity to warm; giving warmth; as, a warmfulgarment. [R.] Chapman.
A native chief in Hindostan; a headman. Malcom.
An advocate of, or believer in, monarchy.
Prosperous; well. [Obs.] Wyclif.-- Wel"some*ly, adv. Wyclif.
The system, occupation, character, or manner of pedagogues.Milton.Avocation of pedantry and pedagogism. De Foe.
Dark; obscure; gloomy. "The murkiest den." Shak.A murky deep lowering o'er our heads. Addison.
